spans.s:
mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Wishing to cleanse or purify.
E.
पू to purify, desid. v., शतृ aff.

f. (-षा)
Wish to cleanse or purify.
E.
पू to purify, desid. v., affs. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-लः)
Flatulence, wind in the bowels.
E.
फुल to blow, form irr.

m. (-सः)
The lungs.
E.
स्फुर to swell, deriv. irr. it is also written फुप्फुस.

m. (-पः)
A cake.
E.
पू to purify, aff. पक्.

f. (-ला)
A sort of sweet cake, fried with Ghee or oil.
E.
पूप cake, ला to get or be, aff. क.

f. (-ला)
A baker's or confectioner's shop.
E.
पूप, and शाला a hall.

f. (-ली)
A sort of cake or biscuit, made of meal or barley, half baked or fried.
E.
पूप cake, आङ् before, ला to be or resemble, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीप्; also with कन् added पूपालिका.

f. (-का)
A sort of cake, half baked or fried in oil or Ghee.
E.
पूय a cake, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.
